2116524195538690457.en_summary: I think one of most overlooked parts of $TSLA and $SPCX is how they're already building what could become one massive AI infrastructure ecosystem. SpaceX and xAI have already bought ~$1B of Tesla products including ~$699M in Megapacks for Colossus II while they're now planning a ~$17B Terafab with Starlink being integrated into Cybercab and Grok powering Tesla's in-car AI. And when you add Optimus humanoids working across factories and launch sites alongside plans for orbital compute then you start to see what Elon Inc. could look like with Tesla supplying the power and chips while Starship launches the data centers and Starlink connects them.
2116524195538690457.zh_summary: 我認為 $TSLA 和 $SPCX 最被忽視的部分之一是它們已在構建可能成為一個龐大 AI 基礎設施生態系統的東西。SpaceX 和 xAI 已購買約 10 億美元的 Tesla 產品，包括為 Colossus II 購買約 6.99 億美元的 Megapacks，而他們現在正計劃約 170 億美元的 Terafab，Starlink 將整合到 Cybercab 中，Grok 將為 Tesla 的車載 AI 提供動力。再加上 Optimus 人形機器人在工廠和發射場工作，以及軌道計算的計劃，你就會開始看到 Elon Inc. 的樣子：Tesla 供應電力和芯片，Starship 發射數據中心，Starlink 連接它們。
